name: pi-costlens
description: A pi extension that books the real dollar cost of every assistant message to a feature (git branch), with a local web dashboard, native OS notifications, and a search/note/tag/merge lifecycle.
author: Leo Gutierrez <slay22@users.noreply.github.com>

scripts.test: node --import tsx --test test/extension.test.ts test/footer.test.ts test/lifecycle.test.ts test/notifications.test.ts
scripts.test:watch: node --import tsx --test --watch test/extension.test.ts test/footer.test.ts test/lifecycle.test.ts test/notifications.test.ts
